text: On a quiet Saturday morning, I decided to explore a part of the city I had never visited before. I took a small notebook, a bottle of water, and my camera, then walked toward the river. The streets were almost empty, but a little bakery was already open. The smell of fresh bread drifted through the doorway, and I stopped to buy a warm roll. Farther along, I found a park with tall trees and a narrow wooden bridge. A few people were walking their dogs, while others sat reading in the sunshine. I paused beside the water and listened to the birds. Nothing extraordinary happened that morning, yet I returned home feeling refreshed. Sometimes, a simple change of scenery is all we need to notice the world around us.
